rationale: AI Factory 1.0.2 rewords skills/factory-small/SKILL.md (tests and review checks stated generically with the viewed-stories items as an example, the hotfix root-cause rule in plain prose instead of the 'Iron Law' quote) and bumps manifests. reviewer: Independent read-only review of release/1.4.0 (commits b277b27..8f615d1) on October 2, 2026: PASS for the upstream diffs (orchestrate wording and SCRIPT_VERSION; factory factory-small wording, nothing vendored; spec scalar/parse_simple_yaml AST-identical to e9c04b6), submodule handling (rename, type change, added gitlink and a non-ASCII path probed), gate timeouts (bool, float, string, 0, 3601 and None refused; precedence explicit > planned > 300), records and lock (upstreams.py status ok) and versions. It raised one finding, fixed in a follow-up commit with its tests: staged_gitlink_changes used git diff-index --cached, which obeys submodule.<name>.ignore=all, so a gitlink move in such a repository passed the early check; the call now passes --ignore-submodules=none. A separate error-path review found no defect (an old run.json without timeout, old snapshots without a gitlinks key, a refusal leaving run.json unchanged). The follow-up fix was not re-reviewed independently. Review prose does not authenticate identity.
